basic_details.job_title: NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow (Civil Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NITC) is engaging one Junior Research Fellow on contract for a research project in the Department of Civil Engineering, sponsored by CoEUPD, NITC by MoHUA. The engagement is for 1 year (extendable by one more year), with a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 37000/- + HRA (20%). Candidates need an M.Tech / M.E in Transportation Engineering and a B.Tech / B.E in Civil Engineering, GATE qualified. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 23 December 2026, and the offline interview is on 30 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill in the registration form given with the notice (as annexed).
Attach the most recent CV and soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates in support of your academic qualification/ experience.
Consolidate all the soft copies into a single PDF document.
Email the PDF to [email protected], with a copy to [email protected].
Write the subject line: "Application for JRF (Interpretable Automated Distress Evaluation to Facilitate Maintenance Decisions for Urban Road Network)".
Send the application by 23 December 2026, the last date for application submission.
Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/ experience
No Objection Certificate from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)
important_instructions: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photograph submitted. Applicants already in employment (government or any other organization) must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview, along with the other documents. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

Interpretable Automated Distress Evaluation to Facilitate Maintenance Decisions for Urban Road Network
1 Year (extendable by one more year based on the performance and the availability of fund)
36 Yrs (Age relaxation permitted as per GoI norms)
Department of Civil Engineering, NIT Calicut

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M.Tech / M.E in Transportation Engineering and B.Tech / B.E in Civil Engineering, GATE qualified. Desirable: Knowledge in programming skills Experience in site works/ pavement construction industry Age limit: 36 Yrs. Age relaxation is permitted as per GoI norms. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. For the exact eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow gets a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 37000/-, with HRA at 20% on top of it. The engagement is on contract basis for 1 year. It is extendable by one more year based on the performance and the availability of fund.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill in the registration form given with the notice (as annexed). Attach the most recent CV and soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates in support of your academic qualification/ experience. Consolidate all the soft copies into a single PDF document. Email the PDF to [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . Write the subject line: "Application for JRF (Interpretable Automated Distress Evaluation to Facilitate Maintenance Decisions for Urban Road Network)". Send the application by 23 December 2026, the last date for application submission. Documents named in the notice: Duly filled registration form (as annexed) Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/ experience No Objection Certificate from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first. After shortlisting, eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the interview. The interview is offline and is scheduled for 30 December 2026. The notice does not mention the interview venue or reporting time; these are expected in the email to shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photograph submitted. Applicants already in employment (government or any other organization) must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview, along with the other documents. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow vacancies are there at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) Junior Research Fellow position in the Department of Civil Engineering research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 23 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Tech / M.E in Transportation Engineering and a B.Tech / B.E in Civil Engineering, and must be GATE qualified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 36 Yrs, with age relaxation permitted as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 37000/- + HRA (20%).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA at 20% is paid in addition to the consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 37000/-. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: Fill the annexed registration form, combine it with your latest CV and mark sheets/certificates into one PDF, and email it to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application for JRF (Interpretable Automated Distress Evaluation to Facilitate Maintenance Decisions for Urban Road Network)".

faq.question: Q9. How will the NIT Calicut JRF be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are shortlisted and notified by email, then invited to the offline interview on 30 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is the NIT Calicut JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract engagement for 1 year, extendable by one more year based on the performance and the availability of fund.
